g.text: Receive amount A at the router
Begin one database transaction; record A
left := A
Take the next rule, in order of position
share := floor(A × percentage / 100)
share := fixed amount
take := min(share, left)
Record transfer of take to the rule's target account
left := left − take
Record transfer of left to the remainder account
Commit A and all transfers together
[more rules]
[no more rules]
[percentage rule]
[fixed rule]
[take > 0]
[take = 0]
[left > 0]
[left = 0]
DR-05: A and every transfer it causes are committed together or
not at all. If any step fails, the database transaction is rolled back
and nothing is recorded. The router never holds money.
Whole won only (int64, DR-03). The percentage is of the received
amount A, not of what is left. Each rule takes at most what is left, so
a later rule may receive less than its share, or nothing.
Each transfer records the actor of A as its actor and A's transaction
as its cause, so a split through a group router is credited to the
member who paid.
